objective: Build a quarterly all-status A-share PIT selection and continuous trading system whose fixed rule seeks positive cost-after returns across time, industries, size groups, and market states.

frozen_strategy.scope: all-status ordinary CNY A shares on SSE and SZSE; current-listed-only rosters are forbidden
frozen_strategy.signal_session: last official SSE session of each natural quarter
frozen_strategy.history_policy: require a real daily bar on every one of the exact 253 sessions t-252 through t; no price imputation
frozen_strategy.st_policy: exclude when present in the exact signal-date stock_st positive list
frozen_strategy.universe: top 1000 by exact trailing signal-date ADV20 among base-eligible stocks; ticker ascending breaks the boundary tie
frozen_strategy.long_momentum: adjusted close at t-21 / adjusted close at t-252 - 1
frozen_strategy.short_momentum: adjusted close at t-21 / adjusted close at t-126 - 1
frozen_strategy.market_gate: open only when both cross-sectional universe medians are strictly positive; otherwise target 100% cash
frozen_strategy.portfolio: top 80, 1.25% each, ticker ascending breaks exact score ties; no substitute after a blocked order
diagnostic_only_fields: latest same-quarter bak_basic industry available no later than signal

data_contract.official_sessions: checkpointed and SHA-verified SSE trade_cal; never inferred from existing daily directories
data_contract.market_partitions: daily, daily_basic and adj_factor must have one complete checkpoint entry for every official open session through the market cutoff; file SHA, size, row count and internal trade_date are verified
data_contract.exact_cutoff_allowlist: each formal panel persists every allowed market/ST/industry partition identity and hash so later checkpoint appends cannot rewrite the run
data_contract.stock_st: exact signal-date checkpointed positive-list partition with verified file SHA and internal trade_date
data_contract.industry: latest checkpointed same-quarter bak_basic partition no later than signal; diagnostic only
data_contract.security_master: one checkpointed all-status L/P/D snapshot; future delist dates do not exclude a stock before their effective date
data_contract.alias_policy: current effective-date identity reconstruction; overlapping intervals and unexplained canonical collisions fail; an interval-authoritative vendor row explicitly wins an explained vendor/canonical collision and the collision is counted

search_disclosure.stage1_to_stage3_reproducibility_limit: reported script hashes are retained, but the three exact historical script revisions were overwritten before this protocol was written

screening_execution_contract.purpose: eliminate the candidate with a continuous exact-cost account before investing in the real-share corporate-action layer
screening_execution_contract.stress_cost_change_only: slippage_bps_per_side=10.0; every target and other cost field unchanged
screening_execution_contract.execution_inputs: signal-date ADV20 and vol63/sqrt(252); t+1 ADV or volatility forbidden
screening_execution_contract.entry_block: missing open, proven suspension, or one-price limit-up; no substitute and residual cash remains
screening_execution_contract.exit_block: missing open, proven suspension, or one-price limit-down; old holding carries
screening_execution_contract.daily_missing_bar: carry only with suspend_d proof; otherwise fail
screening_execution_contract.delist: zero recovery on the first official session on or after effective delist_date unless a separately frozen recovery source exists
screening_execution_contract.corporate_actions: embedded once in adjusted total-return prices; explicit split/dividend columns disabled
screening_execution_contract.benchmark: same PIT universe, quarterly top500 ADV20 equal weight, identical execution/cost roles
screening_execution_contract.period_boundary: this signal next-open pretrade NAV to the next signal next-open pretrade NAV
